projects.project_about: Production AI-powered contact enrichment platform at Sprouts.ai supporting intelligent provider orchestration, workflow automation, distributed processing, authentication, caching, and scalable REST APIs.
projects.project_tool: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes
projects.challenge: Coordinate multiple external enrichment providers with async workflows, retries, rate limits, and cost-aware orchestration without sacrificing reliability.
projects.outcome: Shipped production FastAPI microservices with SQLAlchemy, Redis caching, OAuth2/JWT, Alembic, GitHub Actions, and cloud-native CI/CD—improving reliability, maintainability, and infrastructure efficiency.

projects.project_about: Interactive Ask AI concierge on this portfolio: typed or voice conversation with grounded answers about experience, projects, and thesis via a Cloudflare Worker calling Workers AI (Llama), with origin checks, rate limits, and a daily free-quota kill-switch so the demo stays safe on the free tier.
projects.project_tool: React, Vite, Web Speech API, Cloudflare Workers, Workers AI, rate limiting
projects.challenge: Ship a real LLM chat and voice demo on a static GitHub Pages site without exposing provider keys, while bounding abuse and free-tier cost.

projects.project_about: Full-stack blink-tracking wellness system: PyQt6 desktop client with MediaPipe face mesh, FastAPI + JWT backend, offline SQLite sync queue, and a Next.js Chart.js dashboard.
projects.project_tool: Python, FastAPI, PyQt6, MediaPipe, OpenCV, Next.js, SQLAlchemy, JWT, SQLite, PostgreSQL, Docker
projects.challenge: Capture blink metrics on-device, keep working offline, then sync securely to a cloud API and read-only dashboard without storing raw camera frames.
projects.outcome: Shipped a three-tier product (desktop + API + web) with simulated/real tracker modes, JWT auth, per-user data scoping, Dockerized API, pytest coverage, and privacy/security docs.

projects.project_name: Football Video Analysis with Pose + YOLO
projects.project_about: Computer-vision pipeline that combines MediaPipe pose landmarks with YOLOv8 detections to count foot–ball contacts, estimate velocity, infer ball direction, and export an annotated analysis video.
projects.project_tool: Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, Ultralytics YOLOv8, NumPy
projects.challenge: Turn raw football footage into measurable touch and motion signals without calibrated lab cameras.
projects.outcome: Built a touch-release pipeline that overlays live touch counts, velocity estimates, and optical-flow direction onto an annotated output video (Git LFS for large media).

projects.project_name: UAV Path Loss Prediction using Machine Learning
projects.project_about: Random Forest, ANN, KNN, Naive Bayes, and linear models for UAV air-to-air path loss prediction using terrain, elevation, clutter height, and communication parameters—paired with Okumura–Hata / log-distance baselines. Public research code + paper.
projects.project_tool: Python, scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn
projects.challenge: Improve wireless path-loss prediction accuracy for UAV A2A links beyond classical empirical models alone.
projects.outcome: Feature engineering, visualization, and comparative model evaluation across propagation scenarios; paper and notebook linked from the thesis page.

projects.project_about: PyTorch multilayer perceptron regressing Boston median home values from 13 urban and socio-economic features—ML fundamentals notebook with StandardScaler preprocessing and train/test evaluation (test R² ≈ 0.81).

projects.outcome: Trained a 13→64→32→1 MLP with Adam/MSE; notebook documents loss convergence and R² ≈ 0.81 on held-out data.

projects.challenge: Evaluate multiple classifiers on a clinical tabular dataset and surface malignant vs benign prediction quality.
